title: Transgender 18-Year-Old Gets Arrested After Shoplifting $2500 Worth Of Beauty Items
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 10th, 2023. Walgreen employees called police in reference to a transgender 18-year-old who walked in the store and stole a basket load of “Olay’s”, “fragrances” and “Plan B’s” which totalled over $2500. The teen then fled the store in a car with 2 other females who were unaware of he/she had done. The teen had quite a reputation of stealing, it was said that in the prior week, he/she had stole $3000 worth of items. When officers finally caught up to the teen, he had an attitude and seemed to be upset that officers were arresting him for stealing, he/she didn’t seem to understand the scope of what he had done. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
